clauses.title: Scope of Services
clauses.text: Redwood Works shall provide the services described in Exhibit A (the "Services") to Junction Logistics in a professional and workmanlike manner, consistent with industry standards. Any changes to the scope of the Services must be agreed in writing by both parties before work begins.

clauses.title: Term and Renewal
clauses.text: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for an initial term of 12 months, unless earlier terminated as provided herein. The Agreement will renew automatically for successive terms of equal length unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 15 days before the end of the then-current term.

clauses.title: Compensation
clauses.text: In consideration of the Services, Junction Logistics shall pay Redwood Works fees not to exceed $236,000 per invoice period. All invoices are payable within 15 days of receipt. Amounts unpaid after the due date accrue interest at the lesser of 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party agrees to hold in strict confidence all non-public information disclosed by the other party in connection with this Agreement, and to use such information solely to perform its obligations hereunder. This obligation survives termination of this Agreement for a period of 12 months.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon 15 days' written notice to the other party. Either party may terminate immediately upon a material breach by the other party that remains uncured 15 days after written notice of the breach.

clauses.title: Intellectual Property
clauses.text: All work product created by Redwood Works specifically for Junction Logistics under this Agreement shall be the sole property of Junction Logistics upon full payment of the applicable fees. Redwood Works retains ownership of its pre-existing materials, tools, and methodologies.

clauses.title: Governing Law
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Washington, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. The parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Washington.

clauses.title: Entire Agreement
clauses.text: This Agreement, together with its exhibits, constitutes the entire agreement between Junction Logistics and Redwood Works with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous understandings. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by both parties.
